pricing_status: All ranges are editorial planning estimates, not verified Christmas quotes.

stays.name: Mill Street Inn
stays.title:
Exposed brick.
Breakfast in your suite.
stays.intro: A small converted mill with soft linens, warm brick and a separate room for a quiet evening after Rue goes to sleep.
stays.fee: Includes a provisional $50/night extra-guest allowance; tax and any local assessments extra.
stays.fit: Call first: only a few Deluxe suites accommodate three or four. Standard Deluxe, Studio and Townhouse suites allow just two, including children. Request first floor; there is no elevator.
stays.trade: More boutique inn than resort. No pool advertised, and the fireplace Townhouse suites do not fit your party.
stays.basis: Planning estimate, not a Christmas quote. KAYAK reports a $192 January average across room types; that is neither a holiday rate nor a family Deluxe rate. The larger allowance here anticipates the eligible suite and the published $50 additional-occupant fee. Confirm how Rue is charged.

stays.name: Newport Beach Hotel & Suites
stays.title:
Room to spread out.
A pool for winter afternoons.
stays.intro: Water-view rooms, a proper living area and an indoor pool. The easiest of these three to picture as a relaxed family base.
stays.fee: Add $22/night winter destination fee plus tax. Three nights: $966–1,566 before tax, flights and meals.
stays.fit: King bedroom, separate living area with sleeper sofa, kitchenette and washer/dryer. Free Pack ’n Play by request, subject to availability. Elevators serve all floors.
stays.trade: More casual than Ocean House. The beach is across the road, and some suites face the pond. Rooftop hot tub is for adult downtime; outdoor access is weather-dependent.
stays.basis: Planning estimate, not a Christmas quote. A hotel-associated winter weekday promotion started at $99 through April 2026; it has expired and did not establish Christmas suite pricing. KAYAK also shows a much lower winter price level for standard rooms. Budget roughly $200–350 for a standard room or $300–500 for the suite shown here, before the fee and tax; holidays may exceed this.

stays.name: Weekapaug Inn
stays.tag: Closest to the Ocean House feeling
stays.title:
A fireside hideaway.
A quieter kind of luxury.
stays.intro: Ocean House’s sister inn: pond views, lovely shared sitting rooms and a slower pace. The strongest match for the feeling you liked.
stays.fee: Before tax and resort fee. Smaller rooms may cost less, but confirm occupancy for Rue before comparing prices.
stays.fit: A separate living area with daybed or sofa bed. The inn explicitly allows room for a provided crib in this category. Confirm the exact suite and winter operating dates.
stays.trade: A possible saving over Ocean House, not a cheaper Stone House. Family suites can erase the savings. Do not choose it for an indoor pool.
stays.basis: Planning estimate, not a Christmas quote. Relais & Châteaux lists a one-bedroom Garden View suite from $865/night inclusive of taxes and smaller rooms from $545; dates are unspecified and these are not holiday offers. Official select-night discounts have exclusions, so no discount is assumed. Confirm the category name, resort fee and final family total.
